question.prompt: Machine A produces \(3/5\) of all products and has a defect rate of \(1/10\); machine B produces \(2/5\) and has a defect rate of \(1/5\). What is the probability that 1 randomly selected item is defective?

solutions.explanation: Each machine contributes its production share times its defect rate: \((3/5)(1/10)=3/50\) from A and \((2/5)(1/5)=4/50\) from B. Every defective item comes from exactly one machine, so the required probability is \(3/50+4/50=7/50\).
solutions.title: Total probability
